words.definition: A work of art made from stone, metal or clay.
words.example: There's a huge sculpture in the town square.

words.definition: A picture made with paint.
words.example: That painting is worth millions.

words.definition: A public show of art or other objects.
words.example: We went to a photography exhibition on Sunday.

words.definition: A place where art is shown.
words.example: The gallery is free on Thursday evenings.

words.definition: A person who creates art.
words.example: My favorite artist paints with bright colors.

words.definition: An extremely good piece of work.
words.example: The film is a true masterpiece.

words.definition: A picture of a person.
words.example: She painted a portrait of her grandmother.

words.definition: A strong cloth that artists paint on.
words.example: He painted on a large canvas.

words.definition: Writing that uses beautiful or rhythmic language to express feelings.
words.example: She reads poetry before bed.

words.definition: A long story in a book.
words.example: I'm reading a novel set in Paris.

words.definition: The person who makes sure players follow the rules.
words.example: The referee blew the whistle.

words.definition: The person or team that wins a competition.
words.example: She's the world champion in swimming.

words.definition: A competition with many matches, where players try to win.
words.example: He entered a chess tournament.

words.definition: A large place where sports events happen.
words.example: The stadium was packed with fans.

words.definition: A person who is good at sports and competes in them.
words.example: She trains like a professional athlete.

words.definition: A person you play or compete against.
words.example: Our opponents were much stronger.

words.definition: A win in a game, fight or competition.
words.example: We celebrated our victory with pizza.

words.definition: A loss in a game or competition.
words.example: The team accepted their defeat gracefully.

words.definition: A punishment for breaking a rule in a game.
words.example: He scored from a penalty.

words.definition: A group of teams that play against each other.
words.example: Our team is top of the league.

words.definition: To agree to take something.
words.example: Do you accept credit cards?

words.definition: To refuse to accept something.
words.example: They rejected my application.

words.definition: To choose one thing from a group.
words.example: Select a time that works for you.

words.definition: To pay no attention to something.
words.example: He ignored my text.

words.definition: To decide that something is not worth considering.
words.example: Don't dismiss her idea so quickly.

words.definition: To know someone or something because you have seen them before.
words.example: I didn't recognize you with short hair.

words.definition: To say who or what someone or something is.
words.example: Can you identify the man in the photo?

words.definition: To see the difference between things.
words.example: It's hard to distinguish the twins.

words.definition: To show that something is reasonable.
words.example: How can you justify spending so much?

words.definition: To politely refuse an offer.
words.example: He declined the invitation.

words.definition: One of the seven large areas of land on Earth.
words.example: Africa is the second largest continent.

words.definition: The line between two countries.
words.example: We crossed the border at midnight.

words.definition: The city where a country's government is.
words.example: What's the capital of Australia?

words.definition: The number of people who live in a place.
words.example: The city has a population of two million.

words.definition: A large area of a country or the world.
words.example: This region is famous for its wine.

words.definition: The land next to the sea.
words.example: They drove along the coast.

words.definition: A country and its people.
words.example: The whole nation watched the final.

words.definition: An area of land controlled by a country or a ruler.
words.example: The island is a British territory.

words.definition: One half of the earth.
words.example: Australia is in the southern hemisphere.

words.definition: Affecting the whole world.
words.example: Global warming is a serious problem.

words.definition: To make someone calmer or reduce pain.
words.example: Warm milk can soothe a cough.

words.definition: To give medical care to someone.
words.example: The doctor treated him for a broken arm.

words.definition: To make someone healthy again after an illness.
words.example: There's no cure for the common cold.

words.definition: To put medicine into the body with a needle.
words.example: The nurse injected the vaccine into my arm.

words.definition: To lose blood.
words.example: My finger is bleeding.

words.definition: To bring food up from the stomach through your mouth.
words.example: The baby vomited after eating.

words.definition: To suddenly lose consciousness for a short time.
words.example: She fainted in the heat.

words.definition: To walk with difficulty because of an injured leg or foot.
words.example: He limped off the field.

words.definition: To breathe with a whistling sound.
words.example: He wheezes when he climbs the stairs.

words.definition: To be unable to breathe because something blocks your throat.
words.example: Careful, you'll choke if you eat so fast.

words.definition: The power or skill to do something.
words.example: She has the ability to stay calm under pressure.

words.definition: A natural skill.
words.example: He has a real talent for music.

words.definition: A pleasant quality that attracts people.
words.example: She won everyone over with her charm.

words.definition: The quality of being funny, or the ability to enjoy funny things.
words.example: He has a great sense of humor.

words.definition: Being honest and having strong moral principles.
words.example: She's known for her integrity.

words.definition: A very strong feeling or interest.
words.example: Cooking is his passion.

words.definition: A natural feeling that tells you what to do.
words.example: Trust your instinct.

words.definition: The strength to keep doing something for a long time.
words.example: You need stamina to run a marathon.

words.definition: The qualities that make a person different from others.
words.example: She has a warm personality.

words.definition: The inner feeling that tells you what is right or wrong.
words.example: I have a guilty conscience.

words.definition: Expecting a baby.
words.example: She's six months pregnant.

words.definition: Having little or no hair on your head.
words.example: My father went bald in his thirties.

words.definition: Heavier than is healthy.
words.example: The doctor said I'm slightly overweight.

words.definition: Very thin. Often informal.
words.example: He's tall and skinny.

words.definition: Strong, fit and good at sports.
words.example: She has an athletic build.

words.definition: Not having enough water in your body.
words.example: Drink water. You look dehydrated.

words.definition: Able to spread from person to person.
words.example: Chickenpox is very contagious.

words.definition: Affected by germs.
words.example: The cut got infected.

words.definition: Not drunk.
words.example: I'll drive. I'm sober.

words.definition: Having drunk too much alcohol.
words.example: He was too drunk to walk.

words.definition: A large group of soldiers.
words.example: He joined the army at eighteen.

words.definition: The part of a country's military that fights at sea.
words.example: My uncle served in the navy.

words.definition: An object used to hurt or kill.
words.example: The police found a weapon at the scene.

words.definition: A device that explodes.
words.example: The bomb destroyed the bridge.

words.definition: A weapon that flies and explodes where it lands.
words.example: The missile hit its target.

words.definition: An agreement to stop fighting for a short time.
words.example: The two sides agreed to a truce.

words.definition: A person who has been forced to leave their country because of war or danger.
words.example: Thousands of refugees crossed the border.

words.definition: When an army surrounds a place to force people to surrender.
words.example: The city was under siege for months.

words.definition: A person who has served in the armed forces, or has a lot of experience.
words.example: He's a war veteran.

words.definition: An agreement to stop fighting.
words.example: A ceasefire began at midnight.

words.definition: A bowl with holes for draining food.
words.example: Drain the pasta in a colander.

words.definition: A large spoon for serving soup.
words.example: Use the ladle to serve the soup.

words.definition: A tool with sharp holes for shredding food.
words.example: Use a grater for the cheese.

words.definition: A tool for taking the skin off fruit and vegetables.
words.example: Use a peeler for the carrots.

words.definition: A tool for picking up hot food.
words.example: Use tongs to turn the meat.

words.definition: A tool with small holes for separating liquid from food.
words.example: Pour the tea through a strainer.

words.definition: A heavy pan with a long handle.
words.example: Cook the eggs in a skillet.

words.definition: A dish cooked slowly in the oven, or the container it's cooked in.
words.example: She made a chicken casserole.

words.definition: A deep pan with a handle, used on the stove.
words.example: Heat the milk in a saucepan.

words.definition: Knives, forks and spoons.
words.example: Set the table with cutlery.

words.definition: A tool for turning bolts.
words.example: Hand me the wrench.

words.definition: A tool for gripping and bending things.
words.example: Use pliers to pull out the nail.

words.definition: A tool with a sharp edge for cutting stone or wood.
words.example: He carved the wood with a chisel.

words.definition: A heavy metal bar for opening things.
words.example: They opened the crate with a crowbar.

words.definition: Rough paper for smoothing surfaces.
words.example: Rub it with sandpaper.

words.definition: A box for keeping tools.
words.example: He opened his toolbox.

words.definition: The sharp part of a knife or tool.
words.example: The blade is dull.

words.definition: A hard fruit you can eat, or a small metal piece used with a bolt.
words.example: Tighten the nut.

words.definition: A small flat ring used with a bolt, or a washing machine.
words.example: You need a washer for that bolt.

words.definition: A joint that lets a door or lid swing.
words.example: The door hinge is squeaking.
